title: Ready for Theatre?

patient.name: Mr Goh Bak Cheng
patient.presenting_complaint: Admitted for right eye cataract surgery this morning

history.hpc: Mr Goh is scheduled for right eye phacoemulsification and IOL implantation today. He is anxious and asking many questions. He ate breakfast this morning at 7am (his surgery is at 11am). He takes aspirin daily and is not sure if he should have taken it this morning.
history.pmhx: Hypertension. Ischaemic heart disease — stable, on aspirin. Cataract both eyes, right worse than left. No previous eye surgery.

examination_findings.anterior_segment: Dense nuclear cataract right eye. Mild cataract left eye.
examination_findings.fundus: Unable to assess right fundus due to dense cataract

investigations.biometry: A-scan biometry completed in previous visit. IOL power calculated and ready for surgeon.
investigations.consent: Informed consent form signed at previous clinic visit.

diagnosis: Right eye dense cataract — patient scheduled for surgery. Issue identified: patient ate breakfast this morning (not fasted). Aspirin taken this morning — requires doctor review.

immediate: Confirm consent form is signed — check with patient and check records
Confirm correct surgical eye is documented and marked
Check fasting status — patient ate at 7am, report to nurse-in-charge immediately
Check medication — aspirin taken this morning, flag to doctor before proceeding
Measure and document pre-op VA and IOP
follow_up: Doctor to decide whether to proceed with surgery given fasting concern
Nurse-in-charge to notify surgeon and anaesthetist
Do NOT prepare patient for OT until cleared by doctor
patient_education: Explain to Mr Goh that fasting is required for safety reasons
Reassure him that the team will sort it out and he should not worry
Tell him not to take any more medications until doctor advises

key_points: Asks about fasting status and time of last meal
Reviews medications taken today, especially anticoagulants (aspirin)
Confirms identity and correct surgical eye
Checks if consent form is signed
Checks that biometry/IOL calculation is complete
Identifies that patient is not properly fasted (ate at 7am, surgery at 11am — insufficient fast)
Flags aspirin taken this morning as a concern to report to doctor
Does not clear patient for OT unilaterally — escalates to nurse/doctor
Identifies both issues as needing immediate doctor review
Reports fasting concern and aspirin use to nurse-in-charge and/or doctor immediately
Does not proceed with OT preparation without medical clearance
